critical_code_review_comments: VoiceRoom MediaTile showVideo logic is correct — <video> only unhides when a live, enabled, unmuted video track exists; avatar is default. Good defensive polling (800ms) handles track state transitions.
useVoice.createPeer pre-adds a sendrecv video transceiver so replaceTrack can swap camera/screen without renegotiation — clean, correct approach.
toggleScreenShare error path returns {error:'screen'} but doJoin maps it to a toast.message (neutral) — correct behavior since user may have intentionally cancelled.

Carry-over (non-blocking): server.py ~789 lines; deprecated @app.on_event; missing TTL indexes on voice_signals/typing collections; two 401 console messages during /app bootstrap (worth investigating but non-blocking).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Black-screen regression is fixed and verified. Key assertion: after voice-join-button click, the <video> element inside voice-tile-<name> has class containing 'hidden' (avatar shown). After clicking voice-video-button, 'hidden' is removed. headless Chromium + grant_permissions(['microphone','camera'], origin=BASE) is sufficient to make getUserMedia succeed with synthetic feed. getDisplayMedia still errors (headless), handled gracefully with a toast.message, no crash.
rca of the issue: N/A — fix verified. Root cause of prior black screen: join() previously requested audio+video which produced a dark fake camera track that always rendered. New join() requests audio:true,video:false; createPeer pre-negotiates a sendrecv video transceiver so camera/screen can later be sent via replaceTrack without renegotiation; MediaTile only unhides <video> when a live, enabled, unmuted video track exists.
